decision_description: Phase 2 concept alignment is confirmed between the MAESTRO project concept and active call topic HORIZON-CL4-2026-05-DIGITAL-EMERGING-02. Both Tier 2B expected outcomes are mapped to specific project pillars with Tier 3 evidence: EO-01 (significant improvements in autonomy, robustness, and reliability of AI agents through advanced planning, memory management, and reasoning) is addressed by Pillar 1 (Neuro-Symbolic Planning and Reasoning), Pillar 2 (Adaptive Memory Architecture), and the External Tool and API Orchestration Layer, as evidenced in concept_note.md and strategic_positioning.md. EO-02 (innovative multi-agent frameworks for decentralised coordination beyond individual agent capabilities) is addressed by Pillar 3 (Decentralised Multi-Agent Coordination), with operational demonstration in both sector demonstrators, as evidenced in concept_note.md. Mandatory scope requirements SR-01, SR-02 (all three sub-aspects covered), SR-03, SR-04, SR-05, and SR-06 are fully covered with call-specific vocabulary alignment confirmed. SR-07 (TRL 2 start to TRL 5 end) is partially covered: TRL 5 endpoint is confirmed in strategic_positioning.md; TRL 2 start point is not explicitly stated in any concept document and constitutes an open mandatory gap requiring remediation in concept_note.md before Phase 8 drafting. One vocabulary gap identified in EO-01 mapping: the standalone noun 'autonomy' is absent from the concept corpus, though adjectival and adverbial forms appear throughout; this does not invalidate alignment but should be addressed in proposal text. Non-mandatory gaps noted: CC-08 (no explicit identification of previously funded actions to build upon) and CC-12 (no named synergies with specific complementary initiatives). The compliance_profile.json confirms eligibility, ethics review requirement, gender plan requirement, and open science obligations. Topic mapping is written to docs/tier3_project_instantiation/call_binding/topic_mapping.json and concept_refinement_summary.json is written to docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase2_concept_refinement/.
alternatives_considered: Withhold concept alignment confirmation until TRL 2 start point is explicitly added to concept_note.md — rejected because SR-07 partial coverage documents a remediable gap, not a scope disqualification; the mandatory gap is flagged for resolution before Phase 8 and does not prevent downstream Phase 3 WP design from proceeding on the confirmed alignment foundation

Record the TRL 2 start gap as a standalone gap_risk_flagged entry rather than within this concept_alignment entry — deferred; the gap is documented here for traceability; a dedicated gap_risk_flagged entry should be written by the state_recorder agent if the gap remains unresolved at Phase 3 gate evaluation
tier_authority_applied: Tier 2B expected_outcomes.json (docs/tier2b_topic_and_call_sources/extracted/expected_outcomes.json) and scope_requirements.json (docs/tier2b_topic_and_call_sources/extracted/scope_requirements.json); CLAUDE.md §7 Phase 2 — Concept Refinement gate condition requiring topic mapping confirmation, call-specific vocabulary alignment, and absence of unresolved scope conflicts between the concept and Tier 2B
rationale: The concept_refinement_summary.json (run_id: 854fd6e8-59eb-4974-a28a-b402992be516) confirms full topic mapping for both Tier 2B expected outcomes with named Tier 3 evidence references and full or partial coverage for all mandatory scope requirements. The topic_mapping.json confirms EO-01 and EO-02 mappings. The CLAUDE.md §7 Phase 2 gate condition requires that topic mapping is confirmed, concept note vocabulary is aligned with call-specific expected outcomes, and no unresolved scope conflicts remain — all three sub-conditions are met or their gaps are documented rather than silently suppressed. Per CLAUDE.md §9.4, this decision materially affects future interpretation and traceability: Phase 3 WP design must be grounded in the confirmed EO-01 and EO-02 pillar mapping; Phase 5 impact architecture must trace impact claims to the confirmed coverage of Tier 2B expected impacts; Phase 8 drafting must not proceed until the SR-07 TRL 2 gap is resolved. Recording this decision durably in Tier 4 ensures confirmed alignment and open gaps are visible to all downstream agents without reliance on agent memory.
